Messages.Author: Aramis
Messages.Body:
Alamut Questions:

1. Can you burn the counters from Alamut one at a time as needed
during the political action, or must you choose X and then Alamut is
"used" for the political action?

2. (If you can burn them one at a time) Can you burn the counters off
of Alamut one at a time, placing them on separate vampires to avoid
placing all your eggs in one basket?

Just curious,
Aramis

Alamut [AH, FN]
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Assamite
Cost: 1 pool

Master: unique location.
If an Assamite you control successfully bleeds another Methuselah, put
the pool lost by that Methuselah on this card. During a political
action, you may burn X blood from this card to give a vampire you
control X votes for that referendum.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>1. Can you burn the counters from Alamut one at a time as needed
>during the political action, or must you choose X and then Alamut is
>"used" for the political action?

Nope. Uses the "During <X> do <Y> template" so you can only use it once during
a given political action.

Which is really good since my !Tremere (storyline deck) never had to worry
about Alamut (TVC takes care of that!). =P

>2. (If you can burn them one at a time) Can you burn the counters off
>of Alamut one at a time, placing them on separate vampires to avoid
>placing all your eggs in one basket?

Moot since you will have to burn all the counters at once and give them to only
one vampire.

Halcyan 2
